title: LTFRB suspends bus after Ilocos Norte crash injures 20 passengers

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) ordered the preventive suspension of a passenger bus that overturned after colliding with a pickup truck in Bangui, Ilocos Norte, on Oct. 24, leaving 20 passengers injured. The LTFRB in the Ilocos Region said the suspension took effect on the same day as the road mishap as a precautionary measure while authorities investigate the circumstances surrounding the accident.
